RainyAgent bundled Strata runtime

Strata 0.1.39 is Copyright (c) 2026 Niko1221 and the Strata contributors, licensed under MIT.
Source: https://github.com/Niko1221/Strata/tree/6f32ec070f23ced9f50e704d854d775da52591ab
The selected server, tokenizer and GGUF/MTP preparation files are unmodified upstream files. Small upstream routing rankings and integer token-ID subsets are included. No dense/expert model weights, user configurations, credentials or Python virtual environment are included. The user supplies both the main GGUF and its matching MTP model.

This runtime targets Windows x64 and NVIDIA CUDA 13.0. The prebuilt engine includes CUDA architectures 75, 86, 89 and 120 with PTX. A compatible NVIDIA driver is required; this package does not install a driver.

CPython 3.12.14 comes from the pinned python-build-standalone distribution already recorded in the Windows basic component; portablepython/LICENSE.txt retains its licenses.
llama.cpp / gguf-py uses commit 3cf03257f219afbe7334045ff7c6a06ac68c627d. Its MIT license and the ggml MIT license are retained in licenses/. The embedded vendor notices for stb_image, miniaudio, xxHash, sha256, rotate-bits, cpp-httplib and nlohmann/json are also retained there.
NVIDIA cuBLAS 13.0.2.14 and CUDA Runtime 13.0.96 retain their NVIDIA license texts in licenses/. Only the required runtime DLLs are included.
Python dependency licenses are retained in their *.dist-info directories, including NumPy, Jinja2, MarkupSafe, regex, Pillow, psutil, PyYAML, tqdm, requests, certifi, charset-normalizer, idna, urllib3, colorama, attrs, jsonschema, jsonschema-specifications, referencing, rpds-py and typing-extensions.
Strata web font notices remain in server/serve/web/fonts/OFL.txt.
toolpacks/strata-runtime.sources.json in the source repository records each selected input and its SHA-256. runtime-manifest.json records the complete extracted inventory.
